svg.class: pointer-events-none absolute inset-0 h-full w-full overflow-visible
svg.style: position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; overflow: visible;

div.style: position: static; left: 0px; top: 0px; width: 184px; height: 72px; background: none 0% 0% / auto repeat scroll padding-box border-box rgba(0, 0, 0, 0); border: 0px solid rgb(229, 231, 235); border-radius: 0px; color: rgb(15, 23, 42); font-size: 16px; font-weight: 400; font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif; text-align: start; padding: 0px; margin: 0px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: normal; box-sizing: border-box; opacity: 1; transform: none; box-shadow: none; clip-path: none;

span.class: mb-0.5 block truncate text-[10px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider
block break-words font-mono text-sm font-medium leading-tight text-emerald-950 dark:text-emerald-50 cursor-text
span.title: Double-click to rename
